args.description: 读取 single-video-event-analysis skill 的定义文件
创建工作目录并执行 single-video-event-analysis skill 的完整测试链路
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/single-video-event-analysis /mnt/user-data/workspace/single-video-event-analysis
python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
payload = {"source_type":"local_file","video_path":"/mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/fight.mp4","camera_id":"CAM_DEERFLOW_001","target_events":["fight","fall_down","other_abnormal_event"],"output_dir":"/mnt/user-data/outputs/single-video-event-analysis/artifacts/review","coarse_fps":0.2,"dense_fps":1.0,"scene_threshold":0.3,"dense_window":1.0,"max_frames":12}
p = pathlib.Path('/mnt/user-data/workspace/single-video-event-analysis/input.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(payload, p.open('w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/single-video-event-analysis/scripts/run.py --input /mnt/user-data/workspace/single-video-event-analysis/input.json --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/single-video-event-analysis/result.json
